summary: Build a disposable todo application with persistent storage, an HTTP API, a browser UI, validation and application-level acceptance.

acceptance.statement: Todos persist in a JSON store and support create, read, update, complete, search and status filtering.
The stdlib HTTP API exposes list/create/read/update/complete routes with explicit JSON errors.
The browser UI supports create, edit, complete, search and status filtering with accessible controls.
An application-level acceptance run starts the real server, exercises the API end to end and verifies persistence.

features.objective: Implement the persistent todo store and its focused tests.
Implement the accessible browser UI served by the todo app.
Implement the HTTP API over the persistent todo store.
Add and run the application-level acceptance test against the real server.
